findings.title: Eliminated 101-query SQLite N+1 cascade and 755k-row full scans on GET /api/orgs/:orgId/orders
findings.summary: Replaced SCAN orders + USE TEMP B-TREE + 100 per-order user/order_items queries (each scanning 15,000 order_items) with composite index idx_orders_org_status_created, idx_order_items_order_id, and batched WHERE id IN (...) lookups.
findings.skeptic_notes: Verified SQLite EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shifted from SCAN orders + SCAN order_items to SEARCH USING INDEX, identical tie-breaker order, uncontaminated HTTP timing, and exact golden_sha256 match.
findings.improvement_summary: SQLite queries 101 -> 3 (-97.0%), rows scanned 755,050 -> 220 (-100.0%), internal bytes 178.2 KB -> 12.9 KB (-92.7%), uninstrumented p95 95.59 ms -> 1.99 ms (-97.9%) with exact golden SHA-256 parity.

findings.title: Replaced SELECT * full-table load and JS aggregation with covering-index SQL aggregation on GET /api/orgs/:orgId/dashboard
findings.summary: Replaced pulling 5,000 orders + 3 KB blobs into JS with covering-index SQLite SUM/COUNT aggregation and top-5 subquery GROUP BY backed by idx_orders_org_status_user_total.
findings.skeptic_notes: Confirmed COALESCE zero-row safety, deterministic user_id ASC tie-breaking, honest index-entry scan accounting (250 + 255 = 505 examined rows), and exact golden_sha256 match.
findings.improvement_summary: Queries 6 -> 2 (-66.7%), rows examined 5,005 -> 505 (-89.9% covering index), internal bytes 802.1 KB -> 378 B (-100.0%), uninstrumented p95 25.68 ms -> 1.06 ms (-95.9%).

findings.title: Collapsed 4 sequential HTTP shard lookups into parallel Promise.all fan-out
findings.summary: Replaced four sequential HTTP requests (each performing async fs.promises.readFile + zlib.gunzip on local shard files) with concurrent Promise.all.
findings.skeptic_notes: Verified all 4 lookups depend only on orderId and return exact golden_sha256 equivalence.
findings.improvement_summary: Real loopback HTTP + libuv zlib.gunzip uninstrumented p95 dropped 35.63 ms -> 16.56 ms (-53.5%) with identical golden SHA-256.

findings.title: Removed SELECT * blob dump and JSON.parse(JSON.stringify) loop on orders export
findings.summary: Switched to explicit column projection backed by idx_orders_org_created and dropped redundant per-row deep cloning.
findings.skeptic_notes: Approved projection drops unused raw_webhook_payload and audit_trail internal blobs while matching row_ids_sha256 identically.
findings.improvement_summary: HTTP payload dropped 641.3 KB -> 29.9 KB (-95.3%), rows scanned 5,000 -> 200 (-96.0%), uninstrumented p95 34.75 ms -> 2.59 ms (-92.5%) with matching row_ids_sha256.

findings.title: PostgreSQL EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) verification for multi-column index under MVCC
findings.summary: Fixture verifies SQLite B-tree query plans locally; production PostgreSQL shared_buffers and autovacuum visibility-map behavior requires a local Postgres instance.
findings.skeptic_notes: CI runs pure node:sqlite with zero external Postgres service.
findings.unresolved_fact: PostgreSQL Heap Fetches and Index-Only Scan efficiency for idx_orders_org_status_created under concurrent writes.
findings.safe_verification_recipe: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on a disposable local Postgres instance (>=100k rows) before and after CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.

findings.title: Rejected candidate: NDJSON streaming rewrite on limit=50 orders list
findings.summary: Converting the 10.5 KB 50-item paginated JSON payload to chunked NDJSON streaming would break the JSON array contract for zero meaningful memory gain.
findings.skeptic_notes: Confirmed response is already bounded at 10,572 bytes via limit=50 and column projection.
findings.rejection_reason: Payload is already bounded at 10.5 KB and streaming alters API framing.
findings.mitigating_evidence: unslopped-server.js:22-70 limits rows to 50 and omits large webhook/audit columns.
